recommendedRoute.intro: This track offers a moderate walk over approximately 74.8 km, typically taking around 20 hr 10 min to complete. The route features mixed trail conditions, gentle gradients, variable footing, making it suitable for walkers with moderate fitness who are prepared for a longer or more uneven outing. Hikers should be aware of the usual footing and weather checks before departure. Current conditions suggest this route needs extra caution and may be better postponed unless the alerts clear. It is a good option for enjoying local landscapes and time on the trail.
recommendedRoute.explanation: This route is very long (74.8 km, about 20 hours). Consider a shorter route or split this trip into multiple days.
suggestedPrep: Current risk is elevated: consider postponing, shortening, or swapping to a lower-exposure route today.
Extended outing: pack an emergency bivvy/thermal blanket, offline map, and plan a realistic bail-out at the midpoint.
Moderate route: pack 2 L water, trail snacks, and a packable rain layer — weather can turn inside 2 hours up here.
Moderate pace check: at the halfway mark, reassess time and energy — if either is tight, turn back instead of pushing on.
Autumn conditions: wet leaves are slippery on stone steps; add an insulating layer for after-sunset temps.
Newcomer safety: hike with a partner and share your start/ETA with a trusted contact before you lose signal.
